content:
tori (acct): SirenBank sent back their RFP. They want a 10-business-day POC: private deploy into their AWS account, FIPS 140-2 HSM, and a committed 12-month pricing band. They also asked for a one-page capability matrix and a clear key-custody sentence for procurement. Can we scope quickly?

miles (solutions): Quick take: NDA first. Main asks: HSM wiring for on-prem/cloud, latency SLO (they asked p95 <50ms for 32-token replies), and committed pricing tiers. Also they want a short POC commercial term.

ivan (eng): 50ms p95 is feasible with redwood-13B int8 on Dedicated A10s in-region, assuming low-medium QPS and short contexts. Need their expected peak RPS and prompt-length distribution. HSM: we support KMIP & CloudHSM; on-prem HSM requires a reachable KMIP endpoint and allowed ports.

leah (sec): Key custody: for Private/on-prem we require customer-managed keys. Draft language: "Customer retains sole custody of cryptographic keys; Redwood stores only encrypted key references and does not have access to plaintext keys." I'll add to RFI.

tori (acct): Pricing ask: POC rate + monthly committed. Any standard POC discount we should offer? Also they asked for an exec-friendly one-pager for procurement.

miles (solutions): Standard: POC at 40% off committed list for up to 14 days, cap 8 GPUs. Committed tiers: small=4, mid=16, large=64. I'll draft a pricing CSV and a short POC T&Cs snippet.

ivan (eng): I'll produce a capability matrix: rows redwood-7B/13B/70B, columns quant (fp16/int8/int4), p95 latency (32/64 tokens), throughput/GPU, $/token estimate (committed vs burst). Example line: "redwood-13B | int8 | 36ms p95 (32t) | 120 req/s per A10 | $0.0009/token (committed)"

leah (sec): Also request their compliance prompt set (PII examples) so we can run redaction and hallucination tests during the POC. NDA needed before they share.

ticket-bot: Ticket #POC-9101 created and assigned to tori, miles, ivan, leah. Deadline: 2024-11-15.

tori (acct): I'll request NDA, HSM vendor & firmware, VPC CIDR, allowed ports, expected peak RPS, and sample prompts in the handoff email. Please drop the RFI appendix, capability one-pager, and pricing CSV by EOD PST. Thanks! :thumbsup:
